provenance.publisher: National Emergency Medical Services Information System (NEMSIS)
provenance.retrievalMethod: HTTPS download of the official versioned XSD archive and data-dictionary export

elements.name: EMS Agency Unique State ID
elements.definition: The unique ID assigned to the EMS Agency which is associated with all state licensure numbers and information.

elements.name: EMS Agency Number
elements.definition: The state-assigned provider number of the responding agency.

elements.name: EMS Agency State
elements.definition: The state/territory which assigned the EMS agency number.

elements.name: Indications for Invasive Airway
elements.definition: The clinical indication for performing invasive airway management.

elements.name: Date/Time Airway Device Placement Confirmation
elements.definition: The date and time the airway device placement was confirmed.

elements.name: Airway Device Being Confirmed
elements.definition: The airway device in which placement is being confirmed.

elements.name: Airway Device Placement Confirmed Method
elements.definition: The method used to confirm the airway device placement.

elements.name: Tube Depth
elements.definition: The measurement at the patient's teeth/lip of the tube depth in centimeters (cm) of the invasive airway placed.

elements.name: Type of Individual Confirming Airway Device Placement
elements.definition: The type of individual who confirmed the airway device placement.

elements.name: Crew Member ID
elements.definition: The statewide assigned ID number of the EMS crew member confirming the airway placement.

elements.name: Airway Complications Encountered
elements.definition: The airway management complications encountered during the patient care episode.

elements.name: Suspected Reasons for Failed Airway Management
elements.definition: The reason(s) the airway was unable to be successfully managed.

elements.name: Date/Time Decision to Manage the Patient with an Invasive Airway
elements.definition: The date and time the decision was made to manage the patient's airway with an invasive airway device.

elements.name: Date/Time Invasive Airway Placement Attempts Abandoned
elements.definition: The date and time that the invasive airway attempts were abandoned for the patient.

elements.name: Cardiac Arrest
elements.definition: Indication of the presence of a cardiac arrest at any time during this EMS event.

elements.name: Cardiac Arrest Etiology
elements.definition: Indication of the etiology or cause of the cardiac arrest (classified as cardiac, non-cardiac, etc.).

elements.name: Resuscitation Attempted By EMS
elements.definition: Indication of an attempt to resuscitate the patient who is in cardiac arrest (attempted, not attempted due to DNR, etc.) by any EMS.

elements.name: Arrest Witnessed By
elements.definition: Indication of who the cardiac arrest was witnessed by.

elements.name: AED Use Prior to EMS Arrival
elements.definition: Documentation of AED use Prior to EMS Arrival.

elements.name: Type of CPR Provided
elements.definition: Documentation of the type/technique of CPR used by EMS.

elements.name: Therapeutic Hypothermia by EMS
elements.definition: Documentation of EMS initiation of Therapeutic Hypothermia.

elements.name: First Monitored Arrest Rhythm of the Patient
elements.definition: Documentation of what the first monitored arrest rhythm which was noted.

elements.name: Any Return of Spontaneous Circulation
elements.definition: Indication whether or not there was any return of spontaneous circulation.

elements.name: Neurological Outcome at Hospital Discharge
elements.definition: The level of cerebral performance of the patient at the time of discharge from the Hospital.

elements.name: Date/Time of Cardiac Arrest
elements.definition: The date/time of the cardiac arrest (if not known, please estimate).

elements.name: Date/Time Resuscitation Discontinued
elements.definition: The date/time resuscitation was discontinued.

elements.name: Reason CPR/Resuscitation Discontinued
elements.definition: The reason that CPR or the resuscitation efforts were discontinued.

elements.name: Cardiac Rhythm on Arrival at Destination
elements.definition: The patient's cardiac rhythm upon delivery or transfer to the destination.

elements.name: End of EMS Cardiac Arrest Event
elements.definition: The patient's outcome at the end of the EMS event.

elements.name: Date/Time of Initial CPR
elements.definition: The initial date and time that CPR was started by anyone.

elements.name: Who First Initiated CPR
elements.definition: Who first initiated CPR for this EMS event.

elements.name: Who First Applied the AED
elements.definition: Documentation of who first applied the AED for this EMS event.

elements.name: Who First Defibrillated the Patient
elements.definition: Documentation of who first defibrillated the patient.

elements.name: Crew Member ID
elements.definition: The state certification/licensure ID number assigned to the crew member.

elements.name: Crew Member Level
elements.definition: The functioning level of the crew member ID during this EMS patient encounter.

elements.name: Crew Member Response Role
elements.definition: The role(s) of the crew member during response, at scene treatment, and/or transport.

elements.name: Custom Data Element Title
elements.definition: This is the title of the custom data element created to collect information that is not defined formally in NEMSIS Version 3.

elements.name: Custom Definition
elements.definition: The definition of the custom element and how it should be used.

elements.name: Custom Data Type
elements.definition: The data type of the custom element.

elements.name: Custom Data Element Recurrence
elements.definition: Indication if the data element will accept multiple values.

elements.name: Custom Data Element Usage
elements.definition: The Usage (Mandatory, Required, Recommended or Optional) for the Custom Data Element.

elements.name: Custom Data Element Potential Values
elements.definition: The values which are associated with the Custom Data Element. Values would be the choices provided to the user when they document the Custom Data Element.

elements.name: Custom Data Element Potential NOT Values (NV)
elements.definition: NOT Values (NV) associated with the custom element.

elements.name: Custom Data Element Potential Pertinent Negative Values (PN)
elements.definition: Pertinent Negative Values (PN) associated with the custom element.

elements.name: Custom Data Element Grouping ID
elements.definition: ID for custom element grouping.

elements.name: Custom Data Element Result
elements.definition: The actual value or values chosen (if values listed in eCustomConfiguration.06) or result (free text, Date/Time, or number) documented for the Custom Data Element.

elements.name: Custom Element ID Referenced
elements.definition: References the CustomElementID attribute for eCustomConfiguration.CustomGroup.

elements.name: CorrelationID of PatientCareReport Element or Group
elements.definition: References the CorrelationID attribute of an element or group in the PatientCareReport section.

elements.name: Medical Device Serial Number
elements.definition: The unique manufacturer's serial number associated with a medical device.

elements.name: Date/Time of Event (per Medical Device)
elements.definition: The time of the event recorded by the device's internal clock.

elements.name: Medical Device Event Type
elements.definition: The type of event documented by the medical device.

elements.name: Medical Device Waveform Graphic Type
elements.definition: The description of the waveform file stored in Waveform Graphic (eDevice.05).

elements.name: Medical Device Waveform Graphic
elements.definition: The graphic waveform file.

elements.name: Medical Device Mode (Manual, AED, Pacing, CO2, O2, etc)
elements.definition: The mode of operation the device is operating in during the defibrillation, pacing, or rhythm analysis by the device (if appropriate for the event).

elements.name: Medical Device ECG Lead
elements.definition: The lead or source which the medical device used to obtain the rhythm (if appropriate for the event).

elements.name: Medical Device ECG Interpretation
elements.definition: The interpretation of the rhythm by the device (if appropriate for the event).

elements.name: Type of Shock
elements.definition: The type of shock used by the device for the defibrillation (if appropriate for the event).

elements.name: Shock or Pacing Energy
elements.definition: The energy (in joules) used for the shock or pacing (if appropriate for the event).

elements.name: Total Number of Shocks Delivered
elements.definition: The number of times the patient was defibrillated, if the patient was defibrillated during the patient encounter.

elements.name: Pacing Rate
elements.definition: The rate the device was calibrated to pace during the event, if appropriate.

elements.name: Dispatch Reason
elements.definition: The dispatch reason reported to the responding unit.

elements.name: EMD Performed
elements.definition: Indication of whether Emergency Medical Dispatch was performed for this EMS event.

elements.name: EMD Determinant Code
elements.definition: The EMD determinant code reported by dispatch, consisting of the card number, dispatch level, and dispatch mode.

elements.name: Dispatch Center Name or ID
elements.definition: The name or ID of the dispatch center providing electronic data to the PCR for the EMS agency, if applicable.

elements.name: Dispatch Priority (Patient Acuity)
elements.definition: The actual, apparent, or potential acuity of the patient's condition as determined through information obtained during the EMD process.

elements.name: Unit Dispatched CAD Record ID
elements.definition: The unique ID assigned by the CAD system for the specific unit response.

elements.name: Destination/Transferred To, Name
elements.definition: The destination the patient was delivered or transferred to.

elements.name: Destination/Transferred To, Code
elements.definition: The code of the destination the patient was delivered or transferred to.

elements.name: Destination Street Address
elements.definition: The street address of the destination the patient was delivered or transferred to.

elements.name: Destination City
elements.definition: The city of the destination the patient was delivered or transferred to (physical address).

elements.name: Destination State
elements.definition: The state of the destination the patient was delivered or transferred to.

elements.name: Destination County
elements.definition: The destination county in which  the patient was delivered or transferred to.

elements.name: Destination ZIP Code
elements.definition: The destination ZIP code in which  the patient was delivered or transferred to.

elements.name: Destination Country
elements.definition: The country of the destination.

elements.name: Destination GPS Location
elements.definition: The destination GPS Coordinates to which  the patient was delivered or transferred to.

elements.name: Destination Location US National Grid Coordinates
elements.definition: The US National Grid Coordinates for the Destination Location. This may be the Healthcare Facility US National Grid Coordinates.

elements.name: Number of Patients Transported in this EMS Unit
elements.definition: The number of patients transported by this EMS crew and unit.

elements.name: How Patient Was Moved to Ambulance
elements.definition: The method by which the patient was moved to the ambulance from the scene.

elements.name: Position of Patient During Transport
elements.definition: The position of the patient during transport from the scene.

elements.name: How Patient Was Moved From Ambulance
elements.definition: The method by which the patient was moved from the ambulance to the destination.

elements.name: EMS Transport Method
elements.definition: The method of transport by this EMS Unit.

elements.name: Transport Mode from Scene
elements.definition: Indication whether the transport was emergent or non-emergent.

elements.name: Additional Transport Mode Descriptors
elements.definition: The documentation of transport mode techniques for this EMS response.

elements.name: Acuity Upon EMS Release of Patient
elements.definition: The acuity of the patient's condition after this EMS unit's release of the patient.

elements.name: Reason for Choosing Destination
elements.definition: The reason(s) this EMS unit delivered or transferred the patient to the destination.

elements.name: Type of Destination
elements.definition: The type of destination the patient was delivered or transferred to.

elements.name: Hospital In-Patient Destination
elements.definition: The location within the hospital that the patient was taken directly by EMS (e.g., Cath Lab, ICU, etc.).

elements.name: Hospital Capability
elements.definition: The primary hospital capability associated with the patient's condition for this transport (e.g., Trauma, STEMI, Peds, etc.).

elements.name: Destination Team Pre-Arrival Alert or Activation
elements.definition: Indication that an alert (or activation) was called by EMS to the appropriate destination healthcare facility team. The alert (or activation) should occur prior to the EMS Unit arrival at the destination with the patient.

elements.name: Date/Time of Destination Prearrival Alert or Activation
elements.definition: The Date/Time EMS alerted, notified, or activated the Destination Healthcare Facility prior to EMS arrival. The EMS assessment identified the patient as acutely ill or injured based on exam and possibly specified alert criteria.

elements.name: Disposition Instructions Provided
elements.definition: Information provided to patient during disposition for patients not transported or treated.

elements.name: Unit Disposition
elements.definition: The unit disposition for an EMS event identifying whether patient contact was made by this EMS unit/crew.

elements.name: Patient Evaluation/Care
elements.definition: The patient disposition for an EMS event identifying whether a patient was evaluated and care or services were provided.

elements.name: Crew Disposition
elements.definition: The crew disposition for this EMS event identifying which crew provided primary patient care or whether support services were required.

elements.name: Transport Disposition
elements.definition: The transport disposition for an EMS event identifying whether a transport occurred and by which unit.

elements.name: Reason for Refusal/Release
elements.definition: Describes reason(s) for the patient's refusal of care/transport OR the EMS clinician's decision to release the patient.

elements.name: Level of Care Provided per Protocol
elements.definition: The general level of care provided to this patient as defined per provider level in local EMS protocols or clinical guidelines.

elements.name: Estimated Body Weight in Kilograms
elements.definition: The patient's body weight in kilograms either measured or estimated.

elements.name: Length Based Tape Measure
elements.definition: The length-based color as taken from the tape.

elements.name: Date/Time of Assessment
elements.definition: The date/time of the assessment.

elements.name: Skin Assessment
elements.definition: The assessment findings associated with the patient's skin.

elements.name: Head Assessment
elements.definition: The assessment findings associated with the patient's head.

elements.name: Face Assessment
elements.definition: The assessment findings associated with the patient's face.

elements.name: Neck Assessment
elements.definition: The assessment findings associated with the patient's neck.

elements.name: Heart Assessment
elements.definition: The assessment findings associated with the patient's heart.

elements.name: Abdominal Assessment Finding Location
elements.definition: The location of the patient's abdomen assessment findings.

elements.name: Abdomen Assessment
elements.definition: The assessment findings associated with the patient's abdomen.

elements.name: Pelvis/Genitourinary Assessment
elements.definition: The assessment findings associated with the patient's pelvis/genitourinary.

elements.name: Back and Spine Assessment Finding Location
elements.definition: The location of the patient's back and spine assessment findings.

elements.name: Back and Spine Assessment
elements.definition: The assessment findings associated with the patient's spine (Cervical, Thoracic, Lumbar, and Sacral) and back exam.

elements.name: Extremity Assessment Finding Location
elements.definition: The location of the patient's extremity assessment findings.

elements.name: Extremities Assessment
elements.definition: The assessment findings associated with the patient's extremities.

elements.name: Eye Assessment Finding Location
elements.definition: The location of the patient's eye assessment findings.

elements.name: Eye Assessment
elements.definition: The assessment findings of the patient's eye examination.

elements.name: Mental Status Assessment
elements.definition: The assessment findings of the patient's mental status examination.

elements.name: Neurological Assessment
elements.definition: The assessment findings of the patient's neurological examination.

elements.name: Stroke/CVA Symptoms Resolved
elements.definition: Indication if the Stroke/CVA Symptoms resolved and when.

elements.name: Lung Assessment Finding Location
elements.definition: The location of the patient's lung assessment findings.

elements.name: Lung Assessment
elements.definition: The assessment findings associated with the patient's lungs.

elements.name: Chest Assessment Finding Location
elements.definition: The location of the patient's chest assessment findings.

elements.name: Chest Assessment
elements.definition: The assessment findings associated with the patient's chest.

elements.name: Barriers to Patient Care
elements.definition: Indication of whether or not there were any patient specific barriers to serving the patient.

elements.name: Last Name of Patient's Practitioner
elements.definition: The last name of the patient's practitioner.

elements.name: First Name of Patient's Practitioner
elements.definition: The first name of the patient's practitioner.

elements.name: Middle Name/Initial of Patient's Practitioner
elements.definition: The middle name or initial of the patient's practitioner.

elements.name: Advance Directives
elements.definition: The presence of a valid DNR form, living will, or document directing end of life or healthcare treatment decisions.

elements.name: Medication Allergies
elements.definition: The patient's medication allergies.

elements.name: Environmental/Food Allergies
elements.definition: The patient's known allergies to food or environmental agents.

elements.name: Medical/Surgical History
elements.definition: The patient's pre-existing medical and surgery history of the patient.

elements.name: Medical History Obtained From
elements.definition: Type of person medical history obtained from.

elements.name: The Patient's Type of Immunization
elements.definition: The immunization type of the patient.

elements.name: Immunization Year
elements.definition: The year associated with each immunization type.

elements.name: Current Medications
elements.definition: The medications the patient currently takes.

elements.name: Current Medication Dose
elements.definition: The numeric dose or amount of the patient's current medication.

elements.name: Current Medication Dosage Unit
elements.definition: The dosage unit of the patient's current medication.

elements.name: Current Medication Administration Route
elements.definition: The administration route (po, SQ, etc.) of the patient's current medication.

elements.name: Presence of Emergency Information Form
elements.definition: Indication of the presence of the Emergency Information Form associated with patient's with special healthcare needs.

elements.name: Alcohol/Drug Use Indicators
elements.definition: Indicators for the potential use of alcohol or drugs by the patient related to the patient's current illness or injury.

elements.name: Pregnancy
elements.definition: Indication of the possibility by the patient's history of current pregnancy.

elements.name: Last Oral Intake
elements.definition: Date and Time of last oral intake.

elements.name: Current Medication Frequency
elements.definition: The frequency of administration of the patient's current medication.

elements.name: Cause of Injury
elements.definition: The category of the reported/suspected external cause of the injury.

elements.name: Mechanism of Injury
elements.definition: The mechanism of the event which caused the injury.

elements.name: Trauma Triage Criteria (High Risk for Serious Injury)
elements.definition: Trauma triage criteria for the red boxes (Injury Patterns and Mental Status and Vital Signs) in the 2021 ACS National Guideline for the Field Triage of Injured Patients.

elements.name: Trauma Triage Criteria (Moderate Risk for Serious Injury)
elements.definition: Trauma triage criteria for the yellow boxes (Mechanism of Injury and EMS Judgment) in the 2021 ACS National Guideline for the Field Triage of Injured Patients.

elements.name: Main Area of the Vehicle Impacted by the Collision
elements.definition: The area or location of initial impact on the vehicle based on 12-point clock diagram.

elements.name: Location of Patient in Vehicle
elements.definition: The seat row location of the vehicle at the time of the crash with the front seat numbered as 1.

elements.name: Use of Occupant Safety Equipment
elements.definition: Safety equipment in use by the patient at the time of the injury.

elements.name: Airbag Deployment
elements.definition: Indication of Airbag Deployment.

elements.name: Height of Fall (feet)
elements.definition: The distance in feet the patient fell, measured from the lowest point of the patient to the ground.

elements.name: OSHA Personal Protective Equipment Used
elements.definition: Documentation of the use of OSHA required protective equipment used by the patient at the time of injury.

elements.name: ACN System/Company Providing ACN Data
elements.definition: The agency providing the Automated Collision Notification (ACN) Data.

elements.name: ACN Incident ID
elements.definition: The Automated Collision Notification Incident ID.

elements.name: ACN Call Back Phone Number
elements.definition: The Automated Collision Notification Call Back Phone Number (US Only).

elements.name: Date/Time of ACN Incident
elements.definition: The Automated Collision Notification Incident Date and Time.

elements.name: ACN Incident Location
elements.definition: The Automated Collision Notification GPS Location.

elements.name: ACN Incident Vehicle Body Type
elements.definition: The Automated Collision Notification Vehicle Body Type.

elements.name: ACN Incident Vehicle Manufacturer
elements.definition: The Automated Collision Notification Vehicle Manufacturer (e.g., General Motors, Ford, BMW, etc.).

elements.name: ACN Incident Vehicle Make
elements.definition: The Automated Collision Notification Vehicle Make (e.g., Cadillac, Ford, BMW, etc.).

elements.name: ACN Incident Vehicle Model
elements.definition: The Automated Collision Notification Vehicle Model (e.g., Escalade, Taurus, X6M, etc.).

elements.name: ACN Incident Vehicle Model Year
elements.definition: The Automated Collision Notification Vehicle Model Year (e.g., 2010).

elements.name: ACN Incident Multiple Impacts
elements.definition: The Automated Collision Notification Indication of Multiple Impacts associated with the collision.

elements.name: ACN Incident Delta Velocity
elements.definition: The Automated Collision Notification Delta Velocity (Delta V) force associated with the crash.

elements.name: ACN High Probability of Injury
elements.definition: The Automated Collision Notification of the High Probability of Injury.

elements.name: ACN Incident PDOF
elements.definition: The Automated Collision Notification Principal Direction of Force (PDOF).

elements.name: ACN Incident Rollover
elements.definition: The Automated Collision Notification Indication that the Vehicle Rolled Over.

elements.name: ACN Vehicle Seat Location
elements.definition: The Automated Collision Notification Indication of the Occupant(s) Seat Location(s) within the vehicle.

elements.name: Seat Occupied
elements.definition: Indication if seat is occupied based on seat sensor data.

elements.name: ACN Incident Seatbelt Use
elements.definition: The Automated Collision Notification Indication of Seatbelt use by the occupant(s).

elements.name: ACN Incident Airbag Deployed
elements.definition: The Automated Collision Notification Indication of Airbag Deployment.

elements.name: Date/Time of Laboratory or Imaging Result
elements.definition: The date and time for the specific laboratory result.

elements.name: Study/Result Prior to this Unit's EMS Care
elements.definition: Indicates that the laboratory result occurred prior to this EMS units care.

elements.name: Laboratory Result Type
elements.definition: The type of the laboratory value.

elements.name: Laboratory Result
elements.definition: The value or result of the laboratory test (Units may vary).

elements.name: Imaging Study Type
elements.definition: The type of x-ray or imaging study.

elements.name: Imaging Study Results
elements.definition: The description or interpretation of the results of the imaging study.

elements.name: Imaging Study File or Waveform Graphic Type
elements.definition: The description of the image study file or waveform graphic stored in Imaging Study File or Waveform Graphic (eLabs.08).

elements.name: Imaging Study File or Waveform Graphic
elements.definition: The imaging study file.

elements.name: Date/Time Medication Administered
elements.definition: The date/time medication administered to the patient.

elements.name: Medication Administered Prior to this Unit's EMS Care
elements.definition: Indicates that the medication administration which is documented was administered prior to this EMS units care.

elements.name: Medication Administered
elements.definition: The medication administered to the patient.

elements.name: Medication Administered Route
elements.definition: The route medication was administered to the patient.

elements.name: Medication Dosage
elements.definition: The dose or amount of the medication administered to the patient.

elements.name: Medication Dosage Units
elements.definition: The unit of medication dosage administered to patient.

elements.name: Response to Medication
elements.definition: The patient's response to the medication.

elements.name: Medication Complication
elements.definition: Any complication (abnormal effect on the patient) associated with the administration of the medication to the patient by EMS.

elements.name: Medication Crew (Healthcare Professionals) ID
elements.definition: The statewide assigned ID number of the EMS crew member giving the treatment to the patient.

elements.name: Role/Type of Person Administering Medication
elements.definition: The type (level) of EMS or Healthcare Professional Administering the Medication. For medications administered prior to EMS arrival, this may be a non-EMS healthcare professional.

elements.name: Medication Authorization
elements.definition: The type of treatment authorization obtained.

elements.name: Medication Authorizing Physician
elements.definition: The name of the authorizing physician ordering the medication administration if the order was provided by any manner other than protocol (standing order) in eMedications.11.

elements.name: Medication Administered by Another Unit
elements.definition: Indicates the medication was administered by someone other than the EMS clinicians in this EMS unit.  This is not for prior to arrival medications, but for medications administered when multiple units/caregivers are on scene simultaneously providing patient care.

elements.name: Patient Care Report Narrative
elements.definition: The narrative of the patient care report (PCR).

elements.name: Review Requested
elements.definition: Indication of whether the PCR needs review by anyone.

elements.name: Potential System of Care/Specialty/Registry Patient
elements.definition: An indication if the patient may meet the entry criteria for an injury or illness specific registry.

elements.name: Personal Protective Equipment Used
elements.definition: The personal protective equipment which was used by EMS personnel during this EMS patient contact.

elements.name: EMS Professional (Crew Member) ID
elements.definition: The ID number of the EMS Crew Member associated with eOther.03, eOther.05, eOther.06.

elements.name: Suspected EMS Work Related Exposure, Injury, or Death
elements.definition: Indication of an EMS work related exposure, injury, or death associated with this EMS event.

elements.name: The Type of Work-Related Injury, Death or Suspected Exposure
elements.definition: The type of EMS crew member work-related injury, death, or suspected exposure related to the EMS response.

elements.name: Natural, Suspected, Intentional, or Unintentional Disaster
elements.definition: Event caused by natural forces or Suspected and Intentional/Unintentional Disasters (terrorism).

elements.name: Crew Member Completing this Report
elements.definition: The statewide assigned ID number of the EMS crew member which completed this patient care report.

elements.name: External Electronic Document Type
elements.definition: Document type which has been electronically stored with PCR.

elements.name: File Attachment Type
elements.definition: The description of the file attachment stored in File Attachment Image (eOther.11).

elements.name: File Attachment Image
elements.definition: The file that is attached electronically to the patient care report.

elements.name: Type of Person Signing
elements.definition: The individual's signature associated with eOther.15 (Signature Status).

elements.name: Signature Reason
elements.definition: The reason for the individuals signature.

elements.name: Type Of Patient Representative
elements.definition: If Patient Representative is chosen as the owner of the signature, this documents the relationship of the individual signing to the patient.

elements.name: Signature Status
elements.definition: Indication that the signature for the Type of Person Signing and Signature Reason has been collected or attempted to be collected.

elements.name: Signature File Name
elements.definition: The name of the graphic file for the signature.

elements.name: Signature File Type
elements.definition: The description of the file attachment stored in Signature Graphic (eOther.18).

elements.name: Signature Graphic
elements.definition: The graphic file for the signature.

elements.name: Date/Time of Signature
elements.definition: The date and time the crew member, patient, patient representative, or facility representative signature was captured.

elements.name: Signature Last Name
elements.definition: The last name of the crew member, patient, patient representative, or facility representative associated with the signature group.

elements.name: Signature First Name
elements.definition: The first name of the crew member, patient, patient representative, or facility representative associated with the signature group.

elements.name: File Attachment Name
elements.definition: The name of the attached file.

elements.name: Emergency Department Disposition
elements.definition: The known disposition of the patient from the Emergency Department (ED).

elements.name: Hospital Disposition
elements.definition: The known disposition of the patient from the hospital, if admitted.

elements.name: External Report ID/Number Type
elements.definition: The Type of External Report or Record associated with the Report/ID Number.

elements.name: External Report ID/Number
elements.definition: The ID or Number of the external report or record in eOutcome.03.

elements.name: Other Report Registry Type
elements.definition: The type of external report/registry that was documented as "other" in eOutcome.03

elements.name: Emergency Department Procedures
elements.definition: The procedures performed on the patient during the emergency department visit.

elements.name: Emergency Department Diagnosis
elements.definition: The practitioner's description of the condition or problem for which Emergency Department services were provided.

elements.name: Date/Time of Hospital Admission
elements.definition: The date and time the patient was admitted to the hospital.

elements.name: Hospital Procedures
elements.definition: Hospital Procedures performed on the patient during the hospital admission.

elements.name: Hospital Diagnosis
elements.definition: The hospital diagnosis of the patient associated with the hospital admission.

elements.name: Date/Time of Hospital Discharge
elements.definition: The date the patient was discharged from the hospital.

elements.name: Date/Time of Emergency Department Admission
elements.definition: The date and time the patient was admitted to the emergency department.

elements.name: Date/Time Emergency Department Procedure Performed
elements.definition: The date/time the emergency department procedure was performed on the patient.

elements.name: Date/Time Hospital Procedure Performed
elements.definition: The date/time the hospital procedure was performed on the patient.

elements.name: Injury Severity Score
elements.definition: The patient's total Injury Severity Score.

elements.name: EMS Patient ID
elements.definition: The unique ID for the patient within the Agency.

elements.name: Last Name
elements.definition: The patient's last (family) name.

elements.name: First Name
elements.definition: The patient's first (given) name.

elements.name: Middle Initial/Name
elements.definition: The patient's middle name, if any.

elements.name: Patient's Home Address
elements.definition: Patient's address of residence.

elements.name: Patient's Home City
elements.definition: The patient's primary city or township of residence.

elements.name: Patient's Home County
elements.definition: The patient's home county or parish of residence.

elements.name: Patient's Home State
elements.definition: The state, territory, or province where the patient resides.

elements.name: Patient's Home ZIP Code
elements.definition: The patient's ZIP code of residence.

elements.name: Patient's Country of Residence
elements.definition: The country of residence of the patient.

elements.name: Patient Home Census Tract
elements.definition: The census tract in which the patient lives.

elements.name: Social Security Number
elements.definition: The patient's social security number.

elements.name: Gender (DEPRECATED)
elements.definition: The patient's gender. (DEPRECATED)

elements.name: Race
elements.definition: The patient's race as defined by the OMB (US Office of Management and Budget).

elements.name: Age
elements.definition: The patient's age (either calculated from date of birth or best approximation) at the time of the incident.

elements.name: Age Units
elements.definition: The unit used to define the patient's age.

elements.name: Date of Birth
elements.definition: The patient's date of birth.

elements.name: Patient's Phone Number
elements.definition: The patient's phone number.

elements.name: Patient's Email Address
elements.definition: The email address of the patient.

elements.name: State Issuing Driver's License
elements.definition: The state that issued the drivers license.

elements.name: Driver's License Number
elements.definition: The patient's drivers license number.

elements.name: Alternate Home Residence
elements.definition: Documentation of the type of patient without a home ZIP/Postal Code.

elements.name: Name Suffix
elements.definition: The patient's name component following family name that may be used to describe a person's position in a family.

elements.name: Patient's Preferred Language(s)
elements.definition: The patient's preferred language(s).

elements.name: Sex
elements.definition: The patient's sex.

elements.name: Primary Method of Payment
elements.definition: The primary method of payment or type of insurance associated with this EMS encounter.

elements.name: Physician Certification Statement
elements.definition: Indication of whether a physician certification statement (PCS) is available documenting the medical necessity or the EMS encounter.

elements.name: Date Physician Certification Statement Signed
elements.definition: The date the Physician Certification Statement was signed.

elements.name: Reason for Physician Certification Statement
elements.definition: The reason for EMS transport noted on the Physician Certification Statement.

elements.name: Healthcare Provider Type Signing Physician Certification Statement
elements.definition: The type of healthcare provider who signed the Physician Certification Statement.

elements.name: Last Name of Individual Signing Physician Certification Statement
elements.definition: The last name of the healthcare provider who signed the Physician Certification Statement.

elements.name: First Name of Individual Signing Physician Certification Statement
elements.definition: The first name of the healthcare provider who signed the Physician Certification Statement.

elements.name: Patient Resides in Service Area
elements.definition: An indication of whether the patient's current residence is within the EMS agency service area.

elements.name: Insurance Company ID
elements.definition: The ID Number of the patient's insurance company.

elements.name: Insurance Company Name
elements.definition: The name of the patient's insurance company.

elements.name: Insurance Company Billing Priority
elements.definition: The billing priority or order for the insurance company.

elements.name: Insurance Company Address
elements.definition: The mailing address of the Insurance Company.

elements.name: Insurance Company City
elements.definition: The insurance company's city or township used for mailing purposes.

elements.name: Insurance Company State
elements.definition: The insurance company's state, territory, or province, or District of Columbia.

elements.name: Insurance Company ZIP Code
elements.definition: The insurance company's ZIP Code.

elements.name: Insurance Company Country
elements.definition: The insurance company's country.

elements.name: Insurance Group ID
elements.definition: The ID number of the patient's insurance group.

elements.name: Insurance Policy ID Number
elements.definition: The ID number of the patient's insurance policy.

elements.name: Last Name of the Insured
elements.definition: The last (family) name of the person insured by the insurance company.

elements.name: First Name of the Insured
elements.definition: The first (given) name of the person insured by the insurance company.

elements.name: Middle Initial/Name of the Insured
elements.definition: The middle name, if any, of the person insured by the insurance company.

elements.name: Relationship to the Insured
elements.definition: The relationship of the patient to the primary insured person.

elements.name: Closest Relative/Guardian Last Name
elements.definition: The last (family) name of the patient's closest relative or guardian.

elements.name: Closest Relative/ Guardian First Name
elements.definition: The first (given) name of the patient's closest relative or guardian.

elements.name: Closest Relative/ Guardian Middle Initial/Name
elements.definition: The middle name/initial, if any, of the closest patient's relative or guardian.

elements.name: Closest Relative/ Guardian Street Address
elements.definition: The street address of the residence of the patient's closest relative or guardian.

elements.name: Closest Relative/ Guardian City
elements.definition: The primary city or township of residence of the patient's closest relative or guardian.

elements.name: Closest Relative/ Guardian State
elements.definition: The state of residence of the patient's closest relative or guardian.

elements.name: Closest Relative/ Guardian ZIP Code
elements.definition: The ZIP Code of the residence of the patient's closest relative or guardian.

elements.name: Closest Relative/ Guardian Country
elements.definition: The country of residence of the patient's closest relative or guardian.

elements.name: Closest Relative/ Guardian Phone Number
elements.definition: The phone number of the patient's closest relative or guardian.

elements.name: Closest Relative/ Guardian Relationship
elements.definition: The relationship of the patient's closest relative or guardian.

elements.name: Patient's Employer
elements.definition: The patient's employer's name.

elements.name: Patient's Employer's Address
elements.definition: The street address of the patient's employer.

elements.name: Patient's Employer's City
elements.definition: The city or township of the patient's employer used for mailing purposes.

elements.name: Patient's Employer's State
elements.definition: The state of the patient's employer.

elements.name: Patient's Employer's ZIP Code
elements.definition: The ZIP Code of the patient's employer.

elements.name: Patient's Employer's Country
elements.definition: The country of the patient's employer.

elements.name: Patient's Employer's Primary Phone Number
elements.definition: The employer's primary phone number.

elements.name: Response Urgency
elements.definition: The urgency in which the EMS agency began to mobilize resources for this EMS encounter.

elements.name: Patient Transport Assessment
elements.definition: Documentation of the patient's transport need based on mobility and/or physical capability.

elements.name: Specialty Care Transport Care Provider
elements.definition: Documentation to show the patient care provided to the patient met the Specialty Care Transport Base Rate requirements.

elements.name: Ambulance Transport Reason Code
elements.definition: The CMS Ambulance Transport Reason Code for the transport.

elements.name: Round Trip Purpose Description
elements.definition: Free text description providing the purpose of the round trip EMS transport based on CR109 field for CMS.

elements.name: Stretcher Purpose Description
elements.definition: Free Text Documentation providing the reason for use of a stretcher in the EMS patient transport.

elements.name: Ambulance Conditions Indicator
elements.definition: Documentation of the CRC03 through CRC07 requirements for CMS billing using X12 transactions.

elements.name: Mileage to Closest Hospital Facility
elements.definition: The mileage to the closest hospital facility from the scene. Documented only if the patient was transported to a facility farther away than the closest hospital.

elements.name: ALS Assessment Performed and Warranted
elements.definition: Documentation that the patient required an ALS assessment and it was performed.

elements.name: CMS Service Level
elements.definition: The CMS service level for this EMS encounter.

elements.name: EMS Condition Code
elements.definition: The condition code associated with the CMS EMS negotiated rule-making process.

elements.name: CMS Transportation Indicator
elements.definition: The CMS Ambulance Fee Schedule Transportation and Air Medical Transportation Indicators are used to better describe why it was necessary for the patient to be transported in a particular way or circumstance.

elements.name: Transport Authorization Code
elements.definition: Prior authorization code provided by the insurance carrier/payer.

elements.name: Prior Authorization Code Payer
elements.definition: The Payer who has provided the Prior Authorization Code.

elements.name: Supply Item Used Name
elements.definition: The name of the supply used on the patient by the EMS Crew during the EMS event.

elements.name: Number of Supply Item(s) Used
elements.definition: The number of the specific supply item used on the patient by the EMS Crew during the EMS event.

elements.name: Payer Type
elements.definition: Payer type according to X12 standard.

elements.name: Insurance Group Name
elements.definition: The name of the patient's insurance group.

elements.name: Insurance Company Phone Number
elements.definition: The phone number for the patient's insurance company.

elements.name: Date of Birth of the Insured
elements.definition: The date of birth of the person insured by the insurance company.

elements.name: Date/Time Procedure Performed
elements.definition: The date/time the procedure was performed on the patient.

elements.name: Procedure Performed Prior to this Unit's EMS Care
elements.definition: Indicates that the procedure which was performed and documented was performed prior to this EMS units care.

elements.name: Procedure
elements.definition: The procedure performed on the patient.

elements.name: Size of Procedure Equipment
elements.definition: The size of the equipment used in the procedure on the patient.

elements.name: Number of Procedure Attempts
elements.definition: The number of attempts taken to complete a procedure or intervention regardless of success.

elements.name: Procedure Successful
elements.definition: Indicates that this individual procedure attempt which was performed on the patient was successful.

elements.name: Procedure Complication
elements.definition: Any complication (abnormal effect on the patient) associated with the performance of the procedure on the patient.

elements.name: Response to Procedure
elements.definition: The patient's response to the procedure.

elements.name: Procedure Crew Members ID
elements.definition: The statewide assigned ID number of the EMS crew member performing the procedure on the patient.

elements.name: Role/Type of Person Performing the Procedure
elements.definition: The type (level) of EMS or Healthcare Professional performing the procedure. For procedures performed prior to EMS arrival, this may be a non-EMS healthcare professional.

elements.name: Procedure Authorization
elements.definition: The type of treatment authorization obtained.

elements.name: Procedure Authorizing Physician
elements.definition: The name of the authorizing physician ordering the procedure, if the order was provided by any manner other than protocol (standing order) in eProcedures.11.

elements.name: Vascular Access Location
elements.definition: The location of the vascular access site attempt on the patient, if applicable.

elements.name: Airway Placement Technique
elements.definition: The manner/equipment used during the placement of the advanced airway.

elements.name: Procedure Performed by Another Unit
elements.definition: Indicates the procedure was performed by someone other than the EMS clinicians in this EMS unit.  This is not for prior to arrival procedures, but for procedures performed when multiple units/caregivers are on scene simultaneously providing patient care.

elements.name: Protocols Used
elements.definition: The protocol used by EMS personnel to direct the clinical care of the patient.

elements.name: Protocol Age Category
elements.definition: The age group the protocol is written to address.

elements.name: Patient Care Report Number
elements.definition: The unique number automatically assigned by the EMS agency for each Patient Care Report (PCR). This should be a unique number for the EMS agency for all of time.

elements.name: Software Creator
elements.definition: The name of the vendor, manufacturer, and developer who designed the application that created this record.

elements.name: Software Name
elements.definition: The name of the application used to create this record.

elements.name: Software Version
elements.definition: The version of the application used to create this record.

elements.name: EMS Agency Number
elements.definition: The state-assigned provider number of the responding agency.

elements.name: EMS Agency Name
elements.definition: The EMS agency's name.

elements.name: Incident Number
elements.definition: The incident number assigned by the 911 Dispatch System.

elements.name: EMS Response Number
elements.definition: The internal EMS response number which is unique for each EMS Vehicle's (Unit) response to an incident within an EMS Agency.

elements.name: Type of Service Requested
elements.definition: The type of service or category of service requested of the EMS Agency responding for this specific EMS event.

elements.name: Standby Purpose
elements.definition: The main reason the EMS Unit is on Standby as the Primary Type of Service for the EMS event.

elements.name: Unit Transport and Equipment Capability
elements.definition: The transport and equipment capabilities of the EMS Unit which responded to this specific EMS event.

elements.name: Type of Dispatch Delay
elements.definition: The dispatch delays, if any, associated with the dispatch of the EMS unit to the EMS event.

elements.name: Type of Response Delay
elements.definition: The response delays, if any, of the EMS unit associated with the EMS event.

elements.name: Type of Scene Delay
elements.definition: The scene delays, if any, of the EMS unit associated with the EMS event.

elements.name: Type of Transport Delay
elements.definition: The transport delays, if any, of the EMS unit associated with the EMS event.

elements.name: Type of Turn-Around Delay
elements.definition: The turn-around delays, if any, of EMS unit associated with the EMS event.

elements.name: EMS Vehicle (Unit) Number
elements.definition: The unique physical vehicle number of the responding unit.

elements.name: EMS Unit Call Sign
elements.definition: The EMS unit number used to dispatch and communicate with the unit. This may be the same as the EMS Unit/Vehicle Number in many agencies.

elements.name: Vehicle Dispatch Location
elements.definition: The geographic location of the EMS unit or crew at the time of dispatch.

elements.name: Vehicle Dispatch GPS Location
elements.definition: The GPS coordinates associated with the EMS unit at the time of dispatch documented in decimal degrees.

elements.name: Vehicle Dispatch Location US National Grid Coordinates
elements.definition: The US National Grid Coordinates for the EMS Vehicle's Dispatch Location.

elements.name: Beginning Odometer Reading of Responding Vehicle
elements.definition: The mileage (counter or odometer reading) of the vehicle at the beginning of the call (when the wheels begin moving). If EMS vehicle/unit is via water or air travel document the number in "hours" as it relates to the documentation of Boat, Fixed Wing, or Rotor Craft in eDisposition.16 (EMS Transport Method).

elements.name: On-Scene Odometer Reading of Responding Vehicle
elements.definition: The mileage (counter or odometer reading) of the vehicle when it arrives at the scene. If EMS vehicle/unit is via water or air travel document the number in "hours" as it relates to the documentation of Boat, Fixed Wing, or Rotor Craft in eDisposition.16 (EMS Transport Method).

elements.name: Patient Destination Odometer Reading of Responding Vehicle
elements.definition: The mileage (counter or odometer reading) of the vehicle when it arrives at the patient's destination. If EMS vehicle/unit is via water or air travel document the number in "hours" as it relates to the documentation of Boat, Fixed Wing, or Rotor Craft in eDisposition.16 (EMS Transport Method).

elements.name: Ending Odometer Reading of Responding Vehicle
elements.definition: If using a counter, this is the mileage traveled beginning with dispatch through the transport of the patient to their destination and ending when back in service, starting from 0. If EMS vehicle/unit is via water or air travel document the number in "hours" as it relates to the documentation of boat, Fixed Wing, or Rotor Craft in eDisposition.16.

elements.name: Response Mode to Scene
elements.definition: The indication whether the response was emergent or non-emergent. An emergent response is an immediate response.

elements.name: Additional Response Mode Descriptors
elements.definition: The documentation of response mode techniques used for this EMS response.

elements.name: First EMS Unit on Scene
elements.definition: Documentation that this EMS Unit was the first EMS Unit among all EMS Agencies on the Scene.

elements.name: Other EMS or Public Safety Agencies at Scene
elements.definition: The name(s) of other EMS or public safety agencies at the scene.

elements.name: Other EMS or Public Safety Agency ID Number
elements.definition: The ID number for the EMS Agency or Other Public Safety listed in eScene.02.

elements.name: Type of Other Service at Scene
elements.definition: The type of public safety or EMS service associated with Other Agencies on Scene.

elements.name: Date/Time Initial Responder Arrived on Scene
elements.definition: The time that the initial responder arrived on the scene, if applicable.

elements.name: Number of Patients at Scene
elements.definition: Indicator of how many total patients were at the scene.

elements.name: Mass Casualty Incident
elements.definition: Indicator if this event would be considered a mass casualty incident (overwhelmed existing EMS resources).

elements.name: Triage Classification for MCI Patient
elements.definition: The color associated with the initial triage assessment/classification of the MCI patient.

elements.name: Incident Location Type
elements.definition: The kind of location where the incident happened.

elements.name: Incident Facility Code
elements.definition: The state, regulatory, or other unique number (code) associated with the facility if the Incident is a Healthcare Facility.

elements.name: Scene GPS Location
elements.definition: The GPS coordinates associated with the Scene.

elements.name: Scene US National Grid Coordinates
elements.definition: The US National Grid Coordinates for the Scene.

elements.name: Incident Facility or Location Name
elements.definition: The name of the facility, business, building, etc. associated with the scene of the EMS event.

elements.name: Mile Post or Major Roadway
elements.definition: The mile post or major roadway associated with the incident locations.

elements.name: Incident Street Address
elements.definition: The street address where the patient was found, or, if no patient, the address to which the unit responded.

elements.name: Incident Apartment, Suite, or Room
elements.definition: The number of the specific apartment, suite, or room where the incident occurred.

elements.name: Incident City
elements.definition: The city or township (if applicable) where the patient was found or to which the unit responded (or best approximation).

elements.name: Incident State
elements.definition: The state, territory, or province where the patient was found or to which the unit responded (or best approximation).

elements.name: Incident ZIP Code
elements.definition: The ZIP code of the incident location.

elements.name: Scene Cross Street or Directions
elements.definition: The nearest cross street to the incident address or directions from a recognized landmark or the second street name of an intersection.

elements.name: Incident County
elements.definition: The county or parish where the patient was found or to which the unit responded (or best approximation).

elements.name: Incident Country
elements.definition: The country of the incident location.

elements.name: Incident Census Tract
elements.definition: The census tract in which the incident occurred.

elements.name: First Other EMS or Public Safety Agency at Scene to Provide Patient Care
elements.definition: When there are multiple other EMS Agencies or Public Safety Agencies at the scene, this element documents the other EMS or public safety agency that was first to provide care to the patient.

elements.name: Transferred Patient/Care To/From Agency
elements.definition: Whether primary responsibility for the care of the patient was transferred in the field to or from the EMS agency listed in eScene.02.

elements.name: Date/Time of Symptom Onset
elements.definition: The date and time the symptom began (or was discovered) as it relates to this EMS event. This is described or estimated by the patient, family, and/or healthcare professionals.

elements.name: Possible Injury
elements.definition: Indication whether or not there was an injury.

elements.name: Complaint Type
elements.definition: The type of patient healthcare complaint being documented.

elements.name: Complaint
elements.definition: The statement of the problem by the patient or the history provider.

elements.name: Duration of Complaint
elements.definition: The duration of the complaint.

elements.name: Time Units of Duration of Complaint
elements.definition: The time units of the duration of the patient's complaint.

elements.name: Chief Complaint Anatomic Location
elements.definition: The primary anatomic location of the chief complaint as identified by EMS personnel.

elements.name: Chief Complaint Organ System
elements.definition: The primary organ system of the patient injured or medically affected.

elements.name: Primary Symptom
elements.definition: The primary sign and symptom present in the patient or observed by EMS personnel.

elements.name: Other Associated Symptoms
elements.definition: Other symptoms identified by the patient or observed by EMS personnel.

elements.name: Provider's Primary Impression
elements.definition: The EMS personnel's impression of the patient's primary problem or most significant condition which led to the management given to the patient (treatments, medications, or procedures).

elements.name: Provider's Secondary Impressions
elements.definition: The EMS personnel's impression of the patient's secondary problem or most significant condition which led to the management given to the patient (treatments, medications, or procedures).

elements.name: Initial Patient Acuity
elements.definition: The acuity of the patient's condition upon this EMS unit's arrival at scene.

elements.name: Work-Related Illness/Injury
elements.definition: Indication of whether or not the illness or injury is work related.

elements.name: Patient's Occupational Industry
elements.definition: The occupational industry of the patient's work.

elements.name: Patient's Occupation
elements.definition: The occupation of the patient.

elements.name: Patient Activity
elements.definition: The activity the patient was involved in at the time the patient experienced the onset of symptoms or experienced an injury.

elements.name: Date/Time Last Known Well
elements.definition: The estimated date and time the patient was last known to be well or in their usual state of health. This is described or estimated by the patient, family, and/or bystanders.

elements.name: Justification for Transfer or Encounter
elements.definition: The ordering physician or medical provider diagnosis or stated reason for a hospital-to-hospital transfer, other medical transport, or Mobile Integrated Healthcare encounter.

elements.name: Reason for Interfacility Transfer/Medical Transport
elements.definition: The general categories of the reason for an interfacility transfer/medical transport.

elements.name: PSAP Call Date/Time
elements.definition: The date/time the phone rings (911 call to public safety answering point or other designated entity) requesting EMS services.

elements.name: Dispatch Notified Date/Time
elements.definition: The date/time dispatch was notified by the 911 call taker (if a separate entity).

elements.name: Unit Notified by Dispatch Date/Time
elements.definition: The date/time the responding unit was notified by dispatch.

elements.name: Dispatch Acknowledged Date/Time
elements.definition: The date/time the dispatch was acknowledged by the EMS Unit.

elements.name: Unit En Route Date/Time
elements.definition: The date/time the unit responded; that is, the time the vehicle started moving.

elements.name: Unit Arrived on Scene Date/Time
elements.definition: The date/time the responding unit arrived on the scene; that is, the time the vehicle stopped moving at the scene.

elements.name: Arrived at Patient Date/Time
elements.definition: The date/time the responding unit arrived at the patient's side.

elements.name: Transfer of EMS Patient Care Date/Time
elements.definition: The date/time the patient was transferred from this EMS agency to another EMS agency for care.

elements.name: Unit Left Scene Date/Time
elements.definition: The date/time the responding unit left the scene (started moving).

elements.name: Arrival at Destination Landing Area Date/Time
elements.definition: The date/time the Air Medical vehicle arrived at the destination landing area.

elements.name: Patient Arrived at Destination Date/Time
elements.definition: The date/time the responding unit arrived with the patient at the destination or transfer point.

elements.name: Destination Patient Transfer of Care Date/Time
elements.definition: The date/time that patient care was transferred to the destination healthcare staff.

elements.name: Unit Back in Service Date/Time
elements.definition: The date/time the unit was back in service and available for response (finished with call, but not necessarily back in home location).

elements.name: Unit Canceled Date/Time
elements.definition: The date/time the unit was canceled.

elements.name: Unit Back at Home Location Date/Time
elements.definition: The date/time the responding unit was back in their service area. With agencies who utilized Agency Status Management, home location means the service area as assigned through the agency status management protocol.

elements.name: EMS Call Completed Date/Time
elements.definition: The date/time the responding unit completed all tasks associated with the event including transfer of the patient, and such things as cleaning and restocking.

elements.name: Unit Arrived at Staging Area Date/Time
elements.definition: The date/time the responding unit arrived at a staging area, prior to arrival on scene.

elements.name: Date/Time Vital Signs Taken
elements.definition: The date/time vital signs were taken on the patient.

elements.name: Obtained Prior to this Unit's EMS Care
elements.definition: Indicates that the information which is documented was obtained prior to the documenting EMS units care.

elements.name: Cardiac Rhythm / Electrocardiography (ECG)
elements.definition: The cardiac rhythm / ECG and other electrocardiography findings of the patient as interpreted by EMS personnel.

elements.name: ECG Type
elements.definition: The type of ECG associated with the cardiac rhythm.

elements.name: Method of ECG Interpretation
elements.definition: The method of ECG interpretation.

elements.name: SBP (Systolic Blood Pressure)
elements.definition: The patient's systolic blood pressure.

elements.name: DBP (Diastolic Blood Pressure)
elements.definition: The patient's diastolic blood pressure.

elements.name: Method of Blood Pressure Measurement
elements.definition: Indication of method of blood pressure measurement.

elements.name: Mean Arterial Pressure
elements.definition: The patient's mean arterial pressure.

elements.name: Heart Rate
elements.definition: The patient's heart rate expressed as a number per minute.

elements.name: Method of Heart Rate Measurement
elements.definition: The method in which the Heart Rate was measured. Values include auscultated, palpated, electronic monitor.

elements.name: Pulse Oximetry
elements.definition: The patient's oxygen saturation.

elements.name: Pulse Rhythm
elements.definition: The clinical rhythm of the patient's pulse.

elements.name: Respiratory Rate
elements.definition: The patient's respiratory rate expressed as a number per minute.

elements.name: Respiratory Effort
elements.definition: The patient's respiratory effort.

elements.name: End Tidal Carbon Dioxide (ETCO2)
elements.definition: The numeric value of the patient's exhaled end tidal carbon dioxide (ETCO2) level measured as a unit of pressure in millimeters of mercury (mmHg), percentage or, kilopascal (kPa).

elements.name: Carbon Monoxide (CO)
elements.definition: The numeric value of the patient's carbon monoxide level measured as a percentage (%) of carboxyhemoglobin (COHb).

elements.name: Blood Glucose Level
elements.definition: The patient's blood glucose level.

elements.name: Glasgow Coma Score-Eye
elements.definition: The patient's Glasgow Coma Score Eye opening response.

elements.name: Glasgow Coma Score-Verbal
elements.definition: The patient's Glasgow Coma Score Verbal response.

elements.name: Glasgow Coma Score-Motor
elements.definition: The patient's Glasgow Coma Score Motor response.

elements.name: Glasgow Coma Score-Qualifier
elements.definition: Documentation of factors which make the GCS score more meaningful.

elements.name: Total Glasgow Coma Score
elements.definition: The patient's total Glasgow Coma Score.

elements.name: Temperature
elements.definition: The patient's body temperature in degrees Celsius/centigrade.

elements.name: Temperature Method
elements.definition: The method used to obtain the patient's body temperature.

elements.name: Level of Responsiveness (AVPU)
elements.definition: The patient's highest level of responsiveness.

elements.name: Pain Scale Score
elements.definition: The patient's indication of pain from a scale of 0-10.

elements.name: Pain Scale Type
elements.definition: The type of pain scale used.

elements.name: Stroke Scale Result
elements.definition: The findings or results of the Stroke Scale Type (eVitals.30) used to assess the patient exhibiting stroke-like symptoms.

elements.name: Stroke Scale Type
elements.definition: The type of stroke scale used.

elements.name: Reperfusion Checklist
elements.definition: The results of the patient's Reperfusion Checklist for potential Thrombolysis use.

elements.name: APGAR
elements.definition: The patient's total APGAR score (0-10).

elements.name: Revised Trauma Score
elements.definition: The patient's Revised Trauma Score.

elements.name: Stroke Scale Score
elements.definition: The stroke score value associated with the stroke scale type listed in eVitals.30.
